preconditions.description: The number of pastures n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of paths m must be between 1 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi, li in paths)
preconditions.description: Each path must connect two distinct pastures within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= li <= 10**9 for ai, bi, li in paths)
preconditions.description: Each path length li must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly m lines, one for each path added.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == -1 or (1 <= stdout[i] <= max_length) for i in range(m))
postconditions.description: Each output line must be either -1 or a valid length of the longest paved path.
At least one output line must indicate a valid sunny paving exists.
